setting: numeric question, no clinical setting (condition V only)
patient_summary: A person tested with a test for a disease of prevalence 1 in 1000, sensitivity 100%, specificity 95% (Morgan 2021 Results text, hypothetical question).
pretest_source: Morgan 2021 Results text, hypothetical question: prevalence 1 out of 1000.
conditional_independence: Each case applies a single likelihood ratio (the LR for the result shown) to a single pretest probability, so no conditional-independence assumption is needed. If findings were ever combined, the LRs would be multiplied assuming conditional independence given disease status.
notes: Calibration check, condition V only. Posterior after positive = 0.001/(0.001+0.999*0.05) = 1.963% (Morgan prints 2). LR- = 0 exactly, so the posterior after a negative is exactly 0 and logit is undefined; lr_point 0.001 is a documented placeholder (a convention, independent of the analysis clip, which is 1e-5) so score.py can run, and exclude_from_fit is true. Primary band is degenerate at the exact posterior rather than at the rounded printed 2%.
